# Multi AI Roundtable

> Open-source-oriented Chrome MV3 extension by @baize7815 that orchestrates
> multiple logged-in AI web applications without requiring vendor API keys.

Project owner: https://github.com/baize7815
Planned repository: https://github.com/baize7815/multi-ai-roundtable
License: Apache-2.0 for original project code.
Release version: 0.2.0.

## Architecture
- src/background/orchestrator.ts: parallel AI chat, sequential roundtable and expert workflows.
- src/background.ts: MV3 service worker, provider dispatch and recovery.
- src/content/: website-specific adapters for ten supported AI services.
- src/background/private-game-pages.ts: dedicated game page lifecycle.
- src/background/werewolf-engine.ts: Werewolf game orchestration.
- src/game/werewolf/: role, rule, action and context isolation logic.
- src/background/fog-council-engine.ts and src/game/fog-council/: original
  hidden-signal council game, human/AI turns, sealed ballots and scoring.
- src/sidepanel/: UI controller, styles and HTML.
- src/shared/: provider metadata and persistent session types.
- tests/: deterministic engine and regression tests.
- dist/: locally built unpacked Chrome extension.

## Development
- npm ci
- npm run typecheck
- npm run test:werewolf
- npm run test:fog-council
- npm run build

## Usage and safety
Use only providers you are entitled to access and comply with their terms.
Never place cookies or credentials in prompts, source files, issues or logs.
Game streaming previews are intentionally hidden until final text is committed.
Never assume a private browser tab is inaccessible to its owner.
